title: Five Rooms and One Typewriter
subtitle: 公共管理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 公共管理（社会服务与人际沟通·公共管理与服务）
meta: 主题语境：公共管理（社会服务与人际沟通·公共管理与服务）　|　核心词汇：administration　|　正文 378 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 administration 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my aunt took a job in the ① administration of a town of nine thousand people and said the word administration meant the difference between a decision and a letter about a decision. She had read ② public administration for two years at night, and she said the course had taught her one thing: administration is what happens to a thing after nobody wants it.

The ③ administration she worked in had five rooms and one typewriter, and she said the typewriter was the administration and the rooms were only where it was kept. There was ④ the administration of the rates, then the water, then, after 1971, a bus service nobody used, run ⑤ under the administration of the county, and she said the three had never once been the same job.

Her brother was in a hospital in 1968 where the ⑥ administration of the medicine was written on a card at the end of the bed, and she read the card and found it two days behind, and said nothing for nine hours, then said everything. She said ⑦ the administration of justice in that town was the clerk in room two, meaning a man of twenty-two, and that administration, she said, is only as good as the card at the end of the bed.

In 1979 she was asked to report on the whole district and wrote nine pages, of which one was about the buses; a cousin in America wrote that the ⑧ Administration there had promised nine things and delivered five, and she said it was the same report in another hand. She said the offices had grown from five rooms to forty-one and had not once improved, and that growth is what an administration does instead of improving, and she was told not to write that part down, because administration, they said, is not a subject.

The  administration I think about now is not the buses or the rates but the nine hours she said nothing about that card, which was the only decision she ever made twice. An  administration, she told me in 1986, is only a word for the people who were in the room; every administration is judged by its worst room, and the decisions are made somewhere else, by whoever writes the letter.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 管理；行政（事务）
B. n. 管理部门；行政机构
C. n. 实施；执行；施行
D. n. （某一届的）政府；行政当局
E. 固定搭配：public / business administration 公共／工商管理
F. 固定搭配：the administration of justice 司法；执法
G. 固定搭配：the administration of medicine 用药；给药
H. 固定搭配：under the administration of ... 在……的管理／治理下

items.q: the administration of a town of nine
under the administration of the county
the administration of justice in that town

answers.why: administration 意为“管理、行政事务”，1963 年姑姑到一个九千人小镇的行政部门工作。
public administration 意为“公共管理”，她夜里读了两年公共管理。
administration 意为“管理部门、行政机构”，她所在的部门有五间屋和一台打字机。
the administration of ... 意为“……的施行、执行”，先是按税率征税的施行，接着是水费的施行。
under the administration of ... 意为“在……的管理／治理下”，1971 年后那条没人坐的公交线路归县里管。
the administration of medicine 意为“用药、给药”，1968 年床尾卡片上记录着用药情况，比实际晚了两天。
the administration of justice 意为“司法、执法”，她说那个镇上的司法就是二号房间那个二十二岁的办事员。
the Administration 意为“（某一届的）政府、行政当局”，美国的表亲说那一届政府承诺了九件事，只兑现了五件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年姑姑到一个九千人小镇的行政部门工作，她说这个词就是决定与公函之间的差别。（administration）
她夜里读了两年公共管理，那门课只教会了她一件事。（public administration）
她所在的部门有五间屋和一台打字机，她说打字机才是真正的行政部门。（administration）
1968 年她发现床尾卡片上记录的用药比实际晚了两天。（the administration of medicine）
她说那个镇上的司法其实就是二号房间里那个二十二岁的办事员。（the administration of justice）
1979 年美国的表亲写信说，那一届政府承诺了九件事，只兑现了五件。（the Administration）

She read public administration for two years at night, and the course taught her one thing.
The administration she worked in had five rooms and one typewriter, and the typewriter was the administration.
In 1968 she found that the administration of the medicine on the card was two days behind.
She said the administration of justice in that town was the clerk in room two.
In 1979 a cousin in America wrote that the Administration had promised nine things and delivered five.
